title: Core geometric construction of generic embedding
statement: Let $X$ be locally Noetherian and quasi-compact [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion with $Z$ integral [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-pc-integral-scheme], and let $\xi\in X$ satisfy $\overline{\{\xi\}}=i(Z)$. Let $G$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] whose nonzero-stalk locus is $i(Z)$ and whose $\xi$-stalk is annihilated by the maximal ideal of $\mathcal O_{X,\xi}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk, def-weil-residue-field]. For each quasi-coherent ideal $I$ of $\mathcal O_Z$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], there is $r\ge1$ such that, writing $M=(i_*I)^{\oplus r}$ for the specified categorical biproduct, either $M$ is a zero object, or there is a quasi-coherent ideal inclusion $\iota:J\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ surjective at the $\xi$-stalk, and a monomorphism $\tau:JG\hookrightarrow M$ [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk] whose map on $\xi$-stalks is bijective. No property $P$ of modules, choice of a $P$-subobject, or short exact sequence occurs in this assertion.

source.place: Tag 01YL, lemma-property-irreducible-higher-rank-cohomological, third proof paragraph and final ideal intersection argument; Tag 01YE for the generic ideal inclusion. Read the source at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01YL.

proof.text: If i_*I is zero, choose r=1. Every projection from the specified biproduct has zero target, so its identity is zero by biproduct extensionality. This proves the zero alternative directly.

Identify i(genericPoint Z) with ξ using the equality of closures and uniqueness of generic points. Apply the generic-point ideal inclusion to G and transport the annihilation hypothesis. Obtain a mono α:i_*(A^{⊕r})→G invertible on a neighborhood W of ξ, hence bijective at ξ. Since G has nonzero ξ-stalk, r cannot be zero and A cannot be the zero ideal: in either case the source sum, its pushforward, and its ξ-stalk would be zero. Thus r≥1 and A≠0.

Apply the existing common generic lattice lemma to I,A to obtain coherent K and monos b:K→i_*A, d:K→i_*I, both isomorphisms at ξ. Form L=K^{⊕r} and δ=d^{⊕r}:L→M. Use the right-adjoint pushforward biproduct comparison, followed by the biproduct-coproduct comparison, to identify (i_*A)^{⊕r} with i_*(A^{⊕r}); compose b^{⊕r} with this isomorphism and α to obtain a:L→G. Both a and δ are mono. Module stalks preserve finite limits by reflection through the forgetful functor to abelian groups and exactness of abelian sheaf stalks. Comparing stalk biproducts identifies each sum map with a biproduct of isomorphisms. Thus a and δ are bijective at ξ. Finite coherent-sum closure makes L coherent.

Apply coherent_generic_mono_ideal_factor to a:L→G, obtaining J,ι and ψ:JG→L with ψa equal to the product inclusion. The product inclusion is mono, so ψ is mono. The ideal-product stalk formula gives the range of (JG)_ξ→G_ξ as the image ideal of ι_ξ times G_ξ. Since ι_ξ is surjective, that image ideal is the unit ideal, making the product stalk map surjective. For any m in L_ξ, lift a_ξ(m) through this product map; injectivity of a_ξ and ψ_ξ followed by a_ξ equal to the product map show the lift maps to m under ψ_ξ. Therefore ψ_ξ is surjective. Set τ=ψ followed by δ; composition proves that τ is mono and surjective at ξ.

theorem coherent_ideal_patching_generic_embedding_core
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsIntegral Z]
    (ξ : X) (hclosure : closure ({ξ} : Set X) = Set.range i.base)
    (G : X.Modules) (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G)
    (hsupport : {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton (G.presheaf.stalk x)} = Set.range i.base)
    (hkill : ∀ g : X.presheaf.stalk ξ,
      ∀ m : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace ξ).obj G,
        g ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ → g • m = 0)
    (I : Z.IdealSheafData) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ), 1 ≤ r ∧
      let M := @biproduct (Fin r) X.Modules _ _
        (fun _ : Fin r ↦ (pushforward i).obj I.toModules)
        (HasBiproduct.of_hasProduct (fun _ : Fin r ↦ (pushforward i).obj I.toModules))
      (IsZero M ∨
        ∃ (J : X.Modules) (ι : J ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf),
          Mono ι ∧ J.IsQuasicoherent ∧
          Function.Surjective
            ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace ξ).map ι).hom ∧
          ∃ (τ : idealModuleProduct ι G ⟶ M), Mono τ ∧
            Function.Surjective
              ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace ξ).map τ).hom)
